query: Current NWS forecast for Death Valley Furnace Creek daily high temperatures July 11-23 2026, and any heat ridge/heat dome building in second half of July 2026 for Death Valley California
answer:
Research complete. Here's a summary of the findings on Death Valley (Furnace Creek) temperatures and the heat dome pattern for mid-to-late July 2026:

## Key Findings

**NWS Official Forecast (Furnace Creek, accessed Jul 19, 2026):**
- Jul 20: 117°F
- Jul 21: 117°F
- Jul 22: 118°F
- Jul 23: 120°F
- Current conditions at access: 114°F (heat index 113°F); all days labeled "Hot"

**Numerical Model (Open-Meteo) — the trajectory beyond Jul 23:**
- Highs hold ~116°F through Jul 20–22, rise to ~119°F on Jul 23, then **climb to 122–124°F (50–51°C) during Jul 24–28** — the hottest stretch of the outlook. Zero precipitation forecast throughout.

**Heat Dome / Ridge (second half of July 2026):**
- A **persistent Southwest/Great Basin heat dome (upper ridge of high pressure) is confirmed to be strengthening and expanding through late July** (AccuWeather, weather.com, Wikipedia).
- A second "Omega block" heat dome rebuilt over the Great Basin/Plains around **July 12**, setting all-time records in Billings and Salt Lake City, with 125M+ Americans under heat alerts.
- The forecast warming trend (116°F → 122–124°F by Jul 24–28) is consistent with the ridge **amplifying, not weakening**, into late July.

**Caveats:**
- **Jul 11–18 highs are unavailable** — those dates are in the past / outside the 16-day live forecast horizon.
- Values beyond ~7 days (i.e., the 122–124°F peak) carry **reduced confidence** as they are model-only.
- Late-July normal highs are ~116–117°F, so the forecast runs several degrees above normal.
